title: oxydectes scouleri
intro: Oxydectes scouleri, commonly known as Scouler willow, is a small shrub or tree native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions. The bioactive constituents of Oxydectes scouleri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions also include wound healing and soothing skin irritations due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
